The structure of Li2Mg14Fe2 (LiMg7Fe) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a unit cell containing 36 atoms—Li4 Mg28 Fe4—distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Fe and Li each have 12 geometric neighbors (2 Li/10 Mg and 4 Li/8 Mg, respectively), while Mg centers show 12 neighbors involving varying Li, Mg, and Fe counts. The resulting neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 36 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis of 12-vertex Mg-centered polyhedra reveals corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts among selected neighboring pairs.
